notes.title: Full Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Updates:[/h1][/b]
[i][list]
[*] 5+ languages now available
[*] Enhanced sound effects and ambiance with balanced audio
[*] Expanded demo content to reveal more of the game’s mysterious story
[/list][/i]

[h1][b]What Makes Outrun Unique:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] [i]Dual perspectives revealing a complex, twisty story
[*] A blend of suspense, psychological horror, and chilling sound design and graphic design
[*] Realistic, physics-based object interaction – a unique horror experience with a cleaning simulator twist[/i]
[/list]

[b][h1]Upcoming for Full Release:[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*] [i]5+ additional languages
[*] New cleaning techniques inspired by quirky real-life motel stories
[*] And more surprises![/i]
[/list]

[h3]Thank you all for the amazing support as I approach the final release![/h3]
